name: Bifang de Ta - Aliya2 Shuguang
source:
A truth spanning time—connect with Aliya and meet diverse characters from 1,000 years later. In this real-time synchronized adventure, help her escape the Courtyard and team up to uncover the massive corporation’s hidden secrets...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4138920]Steam[/url]]

一樁橫跨時間的真相——與Aliya取得聯繫，結識生活在一千年後的形形色色的人。在這場與現實時間同步推進的冒險中，你將幫她逃出庭院，再與眾人合力揭開巨型企業深藏的秘密……
